rows.description:
Qualification:

1. Education:

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.

• Network or cloud certifications (e.g., CCNA, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Azure Certification) are a plus.

2. Work Experience:

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in system engineering, with a focus on IoT platforms and digital solutions.

• Proven experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining IoT systems.

• Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and edge computing

3. Problem-Solving Skills:

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues promptly.

• Innovative thinking with the ability to develop creative solutions to complex problems.


Responsibilities:

Job Summary:

We are seeking a skilled and motivated System Engineer to join our team, focusing on IoT platforms and digital solutions. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining IoT systems and digital platforms to enhance our operational capabilities and deliver innovative solutions to our clients. This role requires a combination of technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and a passion for cutting-edge technology.


Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, develop, and deploy IoT platforms and digital solutions to meet business requirements.
  2. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate IoT devices with existing systems and platforms.
  3. Ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of IoT solutions.
  4. Monitor and troubleshoot IoT systems, providing timely resolutions to issues.
  5. Develop and implement best practices for IoT system management and maintenance.
  6. Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in IoT and digital solutions.
  7. Create and maintain technical documentation, including system architecture, design specifications, and user manuals.
  8. Provide training and support to internal teams and clients on IoT systems and digital platforms.

Preferred Skills:

  1. Proficiency in networking concepts and technologies (e.g., TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP).
  2. Experience with cloud platforms and services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  3. Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix systems and scripting languages such as Bash.
  4. Familiarity with IoT protocols and standards (e.g., MQTT, CoAP, LoRaWAN).
  5. Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices for IoT systems.
  6. Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  7. Strong project management abilities, with experience in agile methodologies.
  8. Experience with ThingBoard, SCADA systems, PLC programming, and Unified Operation Center (UOC) systems are a plus.

Job Responsibility

เป้าหมายการดำเนินงาน ติดต่อประสานงานกับธนาคารสภาพคล่องและอัตราดอกเบี้ยของต่างประเทศ พิจารณาความเพียงพอของวงเงิน พิจารณาสัญญาเงินกู้ และดูแลให้เป็นไปตามสัญญา กฎหมาย และระเบียบปฏิบัติของหน่วยงานภายนอกที่เกี่ยวข้อง จัดเตรียมข้อมูลทางการเงินและธุรกิจ เพื่อสนับสนุนการบริหารงานด้านทางสำนักการเงิน – บริหารการเงิน และสร้างสัมพันธไมตรีที่ดีกับ สถาบันการเงิน และหน่วยงานที่เกี่ยวข้อง


Scope of Work (สภาวะแวดล้อมและขอบเขตงาน)

1. พิจารณากระแสเงินสดของบริษัทว่าเพียงพอกับการใช้เงินในแต่ละวัน เพื่อพิจารณาการกู้ยืมเงิน

2. พิจารณา และวางแผนเบื้องต้นในการชำระหนี้ ให้เหมาะสมกับกระแสเงินสดของบริษัท

3. ติดต่อธนาคารเพื่อให้ข้อมูลทางธุรกิจ ความต้องการของธุรกิจของแต่ละบริษัท เพื่อให้ธนาคารพิจารณาวงเงินใหม่ เปลี่ยนแปลง หรือแก้ไขวงเงินเดิม

4. พิจารณาสัญญาวงเงินกู้ต่าง ๆ วงเงิน หนังสือค้ำประกัน ในส่วนของการดำเนินการทางธุรกิจ เจรจากับธนาคารพร้อมสรุปรายงานความคืบหน้าให้กับผู้บังคับบัญชา

5. ดำเนินการเพื่อให้เป็นไปตามสัญญาต่าง ๆ มิให้ผิดเงื่อนไข การส่งงบการเงิน เอกสารต่าง ๆ การต่ออายุวงเงิน เพิ่มวงเงินการเจรจาเพิ่มเติมกรณีเงื่อนไขถูกเปลี่ยนแปลงโดยธนาคาร หรือ ตามระเบียบของ กลต. ตลาดหลักทรัพย์ และจากความต้องการของบริษัทเอง

6. พิจารณาข้อมูลทางการเงิน ทางธุรกิจ ประสานกับหน่วยงานต่าง ๆ เพื่อรวบรวมข้อมูล คำถาม คำตอบ ส่งให้ บริษัทจัดอันดับความน่าเชื่อถือ ทั้งในประเทศ และระดับนานาประเทศ

7. พิจารณาทางเลือกในการบริหารแหล่งเงินทุน และผลิตภัณฑ์ทางการเงินใหม่ ๆ ตลอดจนการดำเนินงาน เพื่อให้สามารถเข้าถึงแหล่งเงินทุนต่าง ๆ ได้ เช่น การออกตั๋วแลกเงินระยะสั้น หรือระยะยาว การออกหุ้นกู้ หรือการระดมทุนต่าง ๆ ที่จะมีในอนาคต


Job Qualification

Educations Background(การศึกษา)

  • ปริญญาตรี-โท ด้านบัญชี การเงิน
  • Professional Experiences(ประสบการณ์การทำงาน)
  • มีประสบการณ์ทำงานด้านการเงิน และมีประสบการณ์ในงานด้านธนาคาร หรือการติดต่อธนาคาร
  • มีประสบการณ์การออกตั๋วแลกเงิน หรือหุ้นกู้

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS (ความรู้และทักษะ):

1. มีประสบการณ์และเข้าใจในงานการเงิน การธนาคาร และตลาดเงิน

2. มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ดีในการประสานงานกับผู้อื่นได้

3. ภาษาอังกฤษ ดี-ดีมาก

rows.title: Chief Steward
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Chief Steward, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Maintain high customer service focus with customers in mind.
  • Have a positive attitude, take responsibility and initiative to resolve issues as well as communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.
  • Responsible for guiding Steward Supervisors and Stewards in their jobs.
  • Control and analyze cleanliness standard for kitchen areas, banquet rooms (back of the house), equipment, utensils, guests and team satisfaction, operating supplies, cleaning supplies, payroll, related costs, breakage and loss.
  • Responsible for implementing a detailed cleaning program as scheduled, monitoring the results of each action.
  • Keep up to date with new cleaning supplies, equipment, trends and systems in stewarding.
  • Assist the stewards during operations.
  • Responsible for the proper handling and maintenance of all equipment in the kitchen, storing and safekeeping all flatware, glassware, hollowware, utensils and related equipment.
  • Ensure all cleaning supplies and equipment are sufficiently stocked.
  • Maintain and update the steward operating manual, chemical charts and cleaning chart for the team’s reference.
  • Prepare and monitor the requisition of all chemicals and equipment.
  • Report all accidents and incidents.
  • Conduct and prepare the monthly operating equipment inventory.
  • Report and monitor the breakage and loss report for operating equipment.
  • Prepare purchase requisition for operating equipment and cleaning supplies.
  • Coordinate with the Engineering department for the preventive maintenance system for exhaust, drainage, burners, fryers, refrigerators, freezers and other major equipment.
  • Inspect all stewarding supplies and equipment received, according to the established specification.
  • Ensure that the level of sanitation in all areas of the kitchen, canteen, and storerooms are up to sanitation standards.
  • Check daily that all kitchen equipment and cleaning equipment are in safe and good working condition.
  • Update and review cleaning products, purchase specifications and cleaning methods to ensure the highest possible standard at all times.
  • Gives direction and check set-up of buffet set in the outlet and banquet functions.
  • Provide active supervision during the implementation of cleaning schedules.
  • Monitor the daily, weekly and monthly banquet functions, outlet promotions and activities, to plan for provision of equipment and manpower.
  • Acquire contact from various hotels in the city to secure additional equipment for big functions and events.
  • Knowledgeable on fire safety and security procedures in relation to stewarding operations.
  • Knowledgeable of all job description in stewarding section and capable of performing the tasks as required.
  • Check and maintain the sanitation level of the garbage room, both wet and dry.
  • Coordinate with Finance and Security in processing disposal sales.
  • Actively seek verbal feedback from customers and team members during service period.
  • Assist in the restaurant and bar during busy days or special events.
  • Knowledgeable of departmental standards and able to explain the standards to team members.
  • Assess team members’ performance against departmental standards.
  • Describe, assign and delegate duties and authority for stewarding operations.
  • Plan ahead and ensure adequate resources are available.
  • Ensure shifts are reviewed, handovers and briefings are carried out.
  • Establish good communication and teamwork within the kitchen team and others.
  • Keep the team up to date about departmental, hotel, company activities, special events and restaurant promotions through regular communication meetings and memos.
  • Assist with selecting, training, coaching and developing team members to meet current and future needs of the department and the hotel.
  • Ensure the health, safety and well-being of customers and all team members.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.


What are we looking for?

A Chief Steward serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years working experience in a 5-star category hotel.
  • At least 1 year of Assistant Chief Steward experience in an international brand hotel.
  • Possess a valid health certificate.
  • Able to train and motivate team members.
  • Able to set priorities and complete tasks efficiently.
  • Work well in stressful situations, remain calm under pressure and able to solve problems.
  • Able to work in a moist, hot and sometimes loud environment.
  • Guide and direct the Stewarding team to perform at their best level in terms of quality, hygiene and profitability.
  • Flexible, responds quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
  • Maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
  • Approach all tasks with enthusiasm and seize opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Knowledgeable in HACCP.
  • Good command in English, both verbal and written to meet business needs, preferred.
  • Working experience within Hilton Group, advantageous.

rows.title: Assistant Chief Engineer
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Assistant Chief Engineer, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Direct and supervise the implementation of effective major problem reporting systems and routine maintenance to ensure that buildings, facilities and the surrounding environment are in good condition at all times.
  • Develop the maintenance plan for facilities and equipment, guiding and supervising the maintenance work of employees and external contractors to ensure the smooth implementation of the maintenance plan.
  • Draft specific requirements and evaluate quotations from Purchasing Managers for all works involving external contractors.
  • Negotiate and follow-up with successful contractors to ensure that all work is done in compliance with company, local and regional health and safety standards.
  • Organize and inspect the work of the Warehouse management in the Engineering department, implementing effective inventory management.
  • Assist the Chief Engineer in carrying out long-term evaluation of equipment and make overhaul and re-purchase plans.
  • Ensure the safe and efficient operation of all machine rooms and equipment.
  • Pay attention to fire safety and solve safety hazards promptly to ensure no accidents.
  • Assist the Chief Engineer in developing annual budgets and follow-up to achieve reasonable control.
  • Supervise and manage the implementation of hotel management policies and procedures.
  • Complete and provide all daily reports and reports required by the Chief Engineer, enabling the office of the Deputy Chief Engineer in maintaining a valid record / filing system.
  • Liaise with the Fire, Power Supply, Water Supply, Urban Management and Epidemic Prevention departments to ensure that all requirements are documented and there are supportive recommendations as needed.
  • Reasonable control of personnel to ensure that all employees remain efficient during working hours.
  • Pay attention to employees' daily work performance, conducting regular performance evaluations with employees and provide guidance and advice for their personal development.
  • Advise and organize potential employees to cross-train within the hotel, in other hotels or external institutions if necessary.
  • Advise staff on transfers, promotions, disciplinary actions or dismissals.
  • Recruit staff for the department with the assistance of the Human Resources Manager and Chief Engineer.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties and duties as assigned.
  • The department reserves the right to change or supplement the job description if necessary.


What are we looking for?

An Assistant Chief Engineer serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Junior College graduate.
  • Proficient in English to meet business needs.
  • At least 10 years of experience in hotel / building services or other appropriate engineering fields.
  • At least 5 years in a Duty Engineer position or 2 years in an Assistant Chief Engineer position in a 4 / 5-star hotel.
  • Have specialized knowledge on water treatment, hydraulics, mechanics, chillers, air flows, H.V.A.C., L.V., electronics, sound, TV, lighting, elevators, boilers, pumps, etc.
  • Capable of maintenance for all hotel building services including air-conditioning, ventilation, refrigeration, electrical installation, lighting system, plumbing system, boiler, laundry, kitchen, lift, fire protection, escalator, sound system, TV system, etc.
  • Possess knowledge of the requirements of government regulations and technical rules.
  • Capable of following specifications for hotel services.
  • Possess knowledge of energy conservation.
  • Capable of training Engineering team members.

Position Responsibilities

  • Develops brand plan by tailor regional/global brand strategies to local market needs and define local priorities with tactical implementation plan to prepare for execution and tailors as appropriate for segments.
  • Manges brand financial performance: plan, propose and monitor brand’s expenditures (annual planning and LE forecast), implement actions on variances to achieve brand goal.
  • Develops, implements, and maintains key measurement systems and KPIs to demonstrate impact of brand strategies and programs.
  • Drive innovation in a highly dynamic and competitive market by challenging the status quo.
  • Integrate digital solutions and omnichannel approaches to create exceptional customer experience.
  • Lead promotional activity execution through collaboration across functional team and align with Pfizer & local regulations.
  • Develop new KOLs and engage existing KOLs to sustain strong networking and market development.
  • Establishes strong working relationships at Local and Regional and across functions.
  • Lead training for Customer Facing Team on product positioning and strategies.
  • Work closely with Access & Medical team for external interaction strategy with government & academic stakeholders, including stakeholder strategy, relationship management and development of innovative partnerships to maximize vaccines penetration.


Qualifications:


  • Minimum requirement bachelor’s degree preferred science or pharmacist, master’s degree an advantage
  • At least 3-year pharmaceutical + at least 2-year brand marketing experience
  • Preferred Vaccines or Infectious diseases therapeutic experience +/- consumer campaign initiate/execution experience
  • Brand plan development includes omnichannel strategy with a proven track record of developing innovative strategic solutions and good business results.
  • Marketing Execution and performance metrics.
  • Demonstrate the ability to identify and diagnose customer needs, brand communication gaps and develop activation ideas.
  • Proficiency in English and local language and computer skills especially PPT and Excel
  • Good Interpersonal & leadership skills.
  • Strong ambition for professional development

rows.title: ผู้แทนขาย(ประจำโรงงาน)
rows.description:
Job Purpose

เสนอขายสินค้าและAllocate สินค้าชิ้นส่วนไก่ให้ลูกค้าในเครือให้ได้รับสินค้าตาม Optimize Guide และ Commitment รวมทั้งงานบริการลูกค้าที่เข้ามารับสินค้า ณ.โรงงาน ให้ได้รับความพึงพอใจสูงสุด


Key Responsibities and Activities

- ประสานงานและติดตามการผลิตสินค้าให้ปริมาณและเวลาออกสินค้าเป็นไปตามแผนการผลิตล่วงหน้า

- Allocate สินค้าชิ้นส่วนไก่ให้เป็นไปตาม Commitment และประสานงานแจ้งลูกค้าในเครือ กรณีไม่ได้รับสินค้าตาม Confirm

- เสนอขายสินค้าให้ลูกค้าในเครือ,นอกเครือ ตามปริมาณสินค้าที่มีเหลือหรือที่มีให้จำหน่ายเพิ่มโดยต้องจำหน่ายให้หมดวันต่อวัน และต้องให้ได้ราคาสูงสุด

- ติดตามสินค้าให้การจ่ายสินค้าเป็นไปตามที่ตกลงกับลูกค้า ทั้งปริมาณและช่วงเวลา

- ขออนุมัติจ่ายสินค้าตามลำดับชั้น ในกรณีที่ต้องจ่ายสินค้าเป็นจำนวนมาก

- บริการลูกค้าในเครือให้ลูกค้าเกิดความพึงพอใจสูงสุด

- ปฏิบัติงานขายให้เป็นไปตามขั้นตอนการทำงานเมื่อพบปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าให้รายงานผู้บังคับบัญชาทันทีเพื่อหาแนวทางแก้ไข

- จัดทำรายงานสถานการณ์ประจำวันส่งให้ผู้บังคับบัญชา

- ติดตามการทำประมาณการชิ้นส่วนไก่ประจำสัปดาห์ ทุกวันอังคาร ก่อน 24.00 น.

- Confirm ประมาณการประจำสัปดาห์ ตาม OPT ทุกวันศุกร์ ก่อน 12.00 น. ล่วงหน้า 1 สัปดาห์

- Confirm ยอด Revise รายวัน ก่อน 15.00 น.ของทุกวัน

- ประสานงานเพื่อรับสินค้าจากแหล่งอื่น ๆ ตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย

- ตรวจสอบเอกสาร DO ให้ถูกต้องก่อนส่งมอบให้คลังจ่ายสินค้า

- จัดการชิ้นส่วนรายวัน ตัดช่องทางที่ราคา เพิ่มให้ช่องทางที่ราคาสูง

 

วุฒิการศึกษา : ปริญญาตรี

สาขาวิชา : การขาย,การตลาดและอื่นๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง

ประสบการณ์ : 1-2 ปี

ทางด้าน : งานการขายและบริการลูกค้าชิ้นส่วนหมู

มีความรู้ความสามารถในการใช้คอมพิวเตอร์โปรแกรม Excel Word Powerpoint ได้ดี

มีไหวพริบในการแก้ไขปัญหา สามารถควบคุณอารมณ์ได้เป็นอย่างดี

  • Receive and direct incoming calls to appropriate personnel and voicemail.

  • Schedule and prepare meeting and conference rooms. This includes room setup, placing catering orders, and securing technological equipment. Request building and housekeeping services as needed.
  • Perform general clerical duties including distributing office faxes and packages and ordering office supplies.
  • Track incoming and outgoing packages, mail, and freight. Arrange messenger service as needed. Arrange hospitality services for guests such as transportation, tickets, reservations, etc.
  • Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems while having a limited opportunity to exercise discretion.
  • Impact through clearly defined duties, methods, and tasks are described in detail.
  • Deliver own output by following defined procedures and processes under close supervision and guidance.


What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor's Degree with up to 2 years of job-related experience.
  • Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
  • Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
  • Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

rows.description:
Roles and Responsibilities

  • จัดทำแผนการปฏิบัติงานตรวจสอบภายในให้ครอบคลุมถึงความเสี่ยงที่มีนัยสำคัญของกิจกรรมที่ระบุไว้ในแผนการตรวจสอบประจำปี

  • จัดทำตารางเวลาการทำงาน (Time Schedule) และจำนวนเจ้าหน้าที่ตรวจสอบภายใน ที่ต้องใช้ในการตรวจสอบแต่ละกิจกรรมหรือโครงการตรวจสอบ เพื่อให้การปฏิบัติงานเป็นไปตามแผนการปฏิบัติงานที่กำหนดไว้
  • ประสานงานกับผู้บริหารของหน่วยงานรับตรวจที่เกี่ยวข้อง เกี่ยวกับกิจกรรมที่จะตรวจสอบและกำหนดการเริ่มงาน
  • กำกับ ดูแล สอบทานการปฏิบัติงานของเจ้าหน้าที่ตรวจสอบภายในให้เป็นไปตามแผนการตรวจสอบที่กำหนดไว้ รวมทั้งให้คำแนะนำผู้ตรวจสอบภายใน เพื่อให้มีความเข้าใจเกี่ยวกับงานที่จะตรวจสอบ ขอบเขตของงาน และเทคนิคการตรวจสอบที่จำเป็น เพื่อให้งานตรวจสอบบรรลุวัตถุประสงค์และมีประสิทธิผล
  • สอบทานกระดาษทำการเพื่อให้แน่ใจว่า ขั้นตอนการปฏิบัติงานตรวจสอบ ผลการตรวจสอบ และเอกสารหลักฐานประกอบการตรวจสอบมีความถูกต้อง ชัดเจน และเชื่อถือได้
  • สอบทานและปรับปรุงรายงานผลการตรวจสอบ เพื่อนำข้อบกพร่องที่ตรวจพบ หารือ แลกเปลี่ยนความคิดเห็นกับผู้ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • จัดทำแผนการคัดเลือกเจ้าหน้าที่ตรวจสอบภายใน และแผนการฝึกอบรม พร้อมทั้งจัดทำคู่มือและเอกสารฝึกอบรม 
  • ให้คำปรึกษา ข้อคิดเห็น และคำแนะนำ แนวทางการปฏิบัติตามระเบียบ คำสั่ง และระบบการควบคุมภายในองค์กร
  • ปฏิบัติงานอื่นตามที่ได้รับมอบหมาย


Qualifications

  • เพศชาย/หญิง อายุ 25-30 ปี

  • มีความสามารถด้าน Digital , Social Media, Application for big data and Work corroborations , IOT ระดับ B1 ขึ้นไป(นำมาใช้ในงานได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ)

rows.title: Engineering Technician
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Engineering Technician, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Strictly adhere to staff rules and regulations, the Management and commands from your superiors.
  • Strictly implement the rules and regulations, operate carefully, and ensure the safe operation of the equipment.
  • Ensure the normal operation of the hotel's daily power supply, water supply, gas supply, heating and cooling equipment.
  • Inspect the equipment operation records and shift handover records promptly and accurately.
  • Inspect and maintain the equipment and facilities under your jurisdiction.
  • Save energy and control energy consumption.
  • Follow-up with maintenance works for banquets and meetings, ensuring that the hotel’s banquet and meeting equipment works well.
  • Regularly test run the generator as required to ensure power generation and transmission during power failure.
  • Perform other tasks assigned by the Management.
  • Supervise and inspect the hotel’s Fire department’s fire preventive works and take proper measures to stop any violation of the fire prevention works.
  • Supervise and train technicians and apprentices in their duties, their development of skills and knowledge, preparing them for eligibility to higher grades.
  • Manage working tools and register team members’ names upon usage of the tools.
  • Responsible for recommending disciplinary action for assigned subordinates.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

An Engineering Technician serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Familiar with the operation principle and fault judgment method of large data centre infrastructure (power supply, air conditioning, fire control, security, monitoring, network, etc.).
  • Willing to be engaged in the monitoring post for day shift and night shift for a long period and have enough time to study.
  • Strong sense of responsibility, teamwork, professionalism and learning ability.
  • Active and motivated in work, with a good sense of service.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills, able to work independently.

rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Floor Supervisor, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Responsible for the highest standard of cleaning on assigned floors and guestrooms during your shift.
  • Work closely with the front desk team to ensure correct room status at all times.

  • Ensure compliance of lost and found procedures.
  • Keep floors, linen rooms and pantries neat and tidy.
  • Monitor productivity of the assigned Room Attendant.
  • Check team members’ grooming, personal hygiene and appearance.
  • Assist with team members’ training and development.
  • Provide ongoing advice and support to team members under your supervision.
  • Provide one to one instruction to team members when required.
  • Seek opportunities to improve guest service consistently from guests’ comments.
  • Take appropriate action to resolve guests’ complaints.
  • Ensure all reports are completed on a timely basis.
  • Adhere by the hotel’s policies and procedures, Hilton code of business conduct, the hotel’s team member handbook, security and emergency policies and procedures.
  • Perform any duties assigned by the Management team deemed necessary.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

A Floor Supervisor serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • At least 3 years of guestroom work experience.
  • Good written and verbal skills.
  • Fluent in English to meet busines needs, advantageous.
  • Good knowledge of Housekeeping office’s daily operation.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, housekeeping Opera and OnQ systems.
  • Actively listen to others and build on good ideas.

rows.title: Communication Center Agent
rows.description:
What will I be doing?

As the Communication Center Agent, you will be responsible for performing the following tasks to the highest standards:

  • Actively seeking verbal feedback from customers and team members at every opportunity.
  • Agree on and implement actions to make improvements to customer service.
  • Promote Hilton Honors and its associated benefits to guests who are not already enrolled in the program, ensuring that existing Hilton Honors members receive personal and professional service that recognizes them as important guests and that their benefits are received.
  • Handle complaints promptly and efficiently, taking the necessary action and informing the Guest Service Manager to follow-up where appropriate.
  • Follow-up with guests to ensure satisfaction with problem resolution (service recovery).
  • Positively deal with and learn from customers’ complaints and comments with follow-up and feedback to the Communication Supervisor.
  • Make sure all customer requests and queries are responded to promptly and effectively while assisting on the floor during peak periods each day.
  • Handle all internal and external guest enquiries promptly with minimal delay, directing them to the correct parties with which they wish to speak to and provide information where necessary.
  • Effectively manage all hotel communications, telephone, fax, mail, in a prompt, courteous and efficient manner, ensuring that guests feel welcome when they contact the hotel.
  • Be up to date with information on facilities, attractions, places of interests, sights and activities in and around the hotel.
  • Handle and deliver all messages in a private and confidential manner, ensuring privacy for guests and ensure that the messages are received and delivered clearly, accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Be proactive towards customers, assisting them with any reasonable requests.
  • Knowledgeable of Hilton departmental standards, ensuring consistency of standards throughout the operation by adhering to Hilton brand standards.
  • Familiar with operating the telephone, FCS, OnQ PM and Micros system.
  • Take on an active role in the team by being kind, cooperative, and helpful and never forgetting the person behind the guest.
  • Take on an active role in the Guest Service Centre.
  • Describe, assign and delegate duties and authority for the operation of the department at all times.
  • Understand the situation in other departments and their implications for your own department.
  • Plan ahead and ensure adequate resources are available.
  • Coordinate with the Housekeeping and Engineering departments to ensure cleaning is followed up, ensuring that follow-up procedures are maintained.
  • Communicate effectively with F&B and Kitchen teams to ensure in-room dining’s quality and effectiveness.
  • Ensure that the shift is reviewed, handovers and briefings are carried out.
  • Maintain in-depth technical knowledge and skills required for the job.
  • Maintain guest histories to assist with returning guests.
  • Attend and participate in regular operational and hotel meetings.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as requested by the Communication Supervisor.
  • Understand the goals of the hotel and the department’s role in achieving it, communicating these goals to the team and getting members of the team to work cooperatively with others.
  • Keep up to date about departmental, hotel and company activities through regular communication meetings and memos, including special events and promotions in the restaurants and bars.
  • Be aware of potential highs and lows in the business.
  • Create an environment where “everyone sells”.
  • Forecasting potential costs.
  • Following company control procedures, controlling costs without compromising standards.
  • Understand the quantity and quality of people needed to operate the department.
  • Regularly review individual and team performance against objectives and provide feedback.
  • Participate in annual appraisals in accordance with legal and hotel guidelines and identify individual training needs.
  • Understand relevant Health & Safety legislations and their implications on the operation of the department, communicating to the team their responsibilities within Health & Safety.
  • Ensure that safe and healthy working practices are implemented at all times.
  • Maintain personal presentation to hotel and Hilton standards.
  • Ensure that all reporting and servicing deadlines are met on a timely basis.
  • Adhere to the hotel’s security and emergency policies and procedures.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
  • The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.


What are we looking for?

An Communication Center Agent serving Hilton Brands is always working on behalf of our Guests and working with other Team Members. To successfully fill this role, you should maintain the attitude, behaviours, skills, and values that follow:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in the same position in a 5-star international branded hotel or comparable industry related experience.
  • Understand basic spoken English to meet business needs.
  • Maintain a high customer service focus by approaching your job with the customers always in mind.
  • Positively impact, take personal responsibility and initiative to resolve issues, communicating clearly with both customers and colleagues.
  • Motivated and committed, approaching all tasks with enthusiasm and seizing opportunities to learn new skills or knowledge in order to improve personal performance.
  • Be flexible and respond quickly and positively to changing requirements including the performance of any tasks requested of you.
  • Maintain high team focus by showing co-operation and support to colleagues in the pursuit of team goals.
  • Contribute ideas and suggestions to enhance operational / environmental procedures in the hotel.
  • Good organization and coordination skills.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and self-motivation.
  • Patient and responsible to solve all problems.
  • Able to maintain excellent relations with team members.
  • Able to work under great physical and mental pressure.
  • Actively promote the services and facilities of Hilton brands to guests and suppliers of the hotel.
  • Perform all duties and responsibilities in a manner that ensures your safety and that of others in your workplace.
  • Familiar with computer systems preferred.

10. กำกับดูแลและ ตรวจสอบเอกสาร นิติกรรม ,สัญญาต่างๆระหว่างบริษัทฯกับบุคคลหรือนิติบุคคล อื่นๆ

กับงาน และแนวทางการดำเนินธุรกิจขององค์กร

rows.title: Financial Reporting and Analysis Specialist
rows.description:
Job Responsibility

• Prepare and review the see through NAB-TH financial performance from TBEV central accounting which is consolidated from all NAB BUs (eg. Sermsuk PLC, Oishi PLC, Thaidrinks, MTM, NUMs, TBEV production plants, TBM, TBL, CI and other TBEV businesses).

• Recheck the actual performance and inform the manager about required adjustments to expense allocation errors in order to provide management financial report on time since the existing system cannot support the new business model.

• Provide financial performance by brand, channel and total business, and track actual vs. budget with preliminary analysis.

• Prepare NAB financial peformance presentation for all NAB related meetings.

• Assist the manager to co-ordianate with planning team for actual performance explanation, then planning team will proceed further in reflecting opportunities and risks to the latest estimate P&L.

• Supply chain cost analysis that driven by all Route to Market such as Sermsuk, TBL, Cash Van that impact to NAB profitability.

• Overhead analysis that include Personal cost (Big portion) by entity such as Sermsuk, Oishi, Thai Drinks , MTM to ensure we tracking and monitor the appropriate ratio to Sales


Job Qualification

• Bachelor's Degree of Accounting / Finance or equivalent

• Financial/Management accounting experience more than 3 yrs with auditing experience

• FMCG financial background is preferred

• Able to prepare, review, and analyze P&L statement in all dimensions within the timelines

• Able to handle with stressful situation, and ad hoc works

• Fluent in English language

• Management skills

company.name: Siemens
company.introduction: Siemens AG (Berlin and Munich) is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to cleaner and more comfortable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, the company creates technology with purpose adding real value for customers. By combining the real and the digital worlds, Siemens empowers its customers to transform their industries and markets, helping them to transform the everyday for billions of people. Siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company Siemens Healthineers, a globally leading medical technology provider shaping the future of healthcare. In fiscal 2023, which ended on September 30, 2023, the Siemens Group generated revenue of €77.8 billion and net income of €8.5 billion. As of September 30, 2023, the company employed around 320,000 people worldwide.

Shape the future of mobility with your qualifications and skills.

rows.title: Senior Software Architect
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Understand, communicate, and enforce the company software architecture strategy.
  • Oversee the design, development, and deployment of software solutions.
  • Draft detailed design documents, including System Architecture diagrams, Data Models (ER or UML diagrams), UML State diagrams, etc. as necessary.
  • Evaluate the current state of systems, identifying areas for improvement and proposing strategic plans for enhancement.
  • Translate business needs and requirements into technical specifications for software applications.
  • Lead the software development process, influencing high-level decisions.
  • Define, document, and ensure adherence to application architecture and design standards.
  • Coach and mentor software engineers, programmers, and other team members.
  • Create and maintain design and code standards.
  • Serve as a technical liaison among project managers, developers, and stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • (Prefer) Bachelor/Master's degree in computer science, information technology, software architecture, or related field.
  • 2-3 years of experience leading software development teams.
  • Knowledge of object-oriented programming, functional programming, and software design patterns.
  • Understand the concept of SOA and the pros/cons of Microservices.
  • Familiarity with software development frameworks.
  • Familiarity with software version control systems such as Git and SVN.
  • Experience with agile software development methodologies and testing frameworks, such as xUnit and Selenium.
  • Familiarity with software delivery platforms, such as Atlassian’s Jira.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills.
  • Big-picture problem-solving skill.

rows.title: Sales Performance and Incentive Analyst
rows.description:
Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage incentive programs to boost sales performance and meet our business goals.
  • Analyze sales data to find areas for improvement in our incentive structures.

rows.title: Associate, Mass Account-GM
rows.description:
Job Description

Team and Role Introduction:

The job purpose of an e-commerce senior key account manager is to champion the success of local SMEs sellers, fostering their growth into thriving entities within our dynamic e-commerce ecosystem of Lazada. By harnessing the power of cutting-edge technology and innovative tools, we aim not just to meet, but to exceed sales and advertising revenue targets, driving unprecedented growth and market expansion for sellers. Through collaborative partnerships and strategic investments, we aspire to empower SMEs to realize their full potential, transforming aspirations into remarkable achievements on our Lazada platform.

-Manage a diverse portfolio of 35-40 local SMEs sellers , fostering strong relationships and providing dedicated support.

-Strategically guide SMEs sellers to achieve sustainable growth on the Lazada platform, leveraging technological resources and innovative solutions.

-Drive sales growth and advertising revenue growth in accordance with company objectives, consistently striving to exceed targets and benchmarks.

-Capable in assortment planning & merchandising, adept at optimizing stock and negotiating pricing to drive sales growth.

-Execute tailored strategies, including barter programs and seller investment initiatives, to maximize growth opportunities and enhance seller success.

-Proficient in performing in-depth analysis to drive innovative improvements in commercial excellence, with the ability to spearhead key projects to drive impactful results.

-Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to identify market trends, optimize platform features, and deliver exceptional value to SMEs partners and buyers.

-Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for SMEs, advocating for their needs within the company and championing their success at every opportunity.


Job Requirements

Requirements/Qualifications(must have):

- Minimum of 4 years of professional experience, preferably in roles related to sales, account management, buyer, procurement, retail, or business development.

-Previous experience in industries related to commerce or sales, and direct client-facing roles are highly advantageous.

-Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, to effectively analyze data, create reports, and deliver compelling presentations.

-Possess a proactive "can-do" attitude, self-motivation, and a strong drive to achieve ambitious goals and targets.

-Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with SMEs partners and internal stakeholders.

rows.title: Manager, Regional Brands Campaign Operations-Bangkok
rows.description:
Job Description

Team and Role Introduction:

About the TeamThe Regional Brand Campaigns operations team supports LazMall brands in accelerating buyer and sales growth through the design and management of various Campaigns such as Super Brand Day, Super New Arrival and Super Brand Opening. Our team of Campaign Managers are focused on helping brands achieve their campaign goals through insights sharing, rigorous campaign preparation and cross-functional collaborations.

About the Role As Regional Brand Campaigns manager, you will lead the end-to-end project management of various Campaigns which includes project planning, project execution, optimization and post-campaign analysis. You will be responsible to:

-Ensure timely execution and effective campaign planning operations through the set up of guidelines, processes, templates; adapting these as required to category/brand nuances.

-Understand the end-to-end shopping journey and marry that with data analysis to recommend action plans at each touchpoint to deliver campaign goals.

-Champion and govern high quality, integrated co-branded marketing campaigns to delight our buyers, supporting brands through insights and best practices sharing.

-Work with Product and Business Intelligence teams to identify opportunities to enhance the operations process or buyer experience.

Job Requirements

Requirements/Qualifications(must have):

-At least 3-5 years of experience in brand management, consumer marketing, digital marketing or account management roles.

-Strong understanding of Southeast Asia eCommerce landscape and how shoppers interact with marketplace platforms.

-Independent, organized and proactive– with proven ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, prioritize and execute with timeliness in a fast-paced environment

-Strong data analysis skills with aptitude to translate into actionable insights

-Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills

-Demonstrated ability to solve problems in a pragmatic and effective manner

-High professionalism to confidently partner with Brands from various industries

-Knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

-Excellent command of English (both written and verbal)


Requirements/Qualifications(good to have):

Preferred qualifications

-The ideal candidate has a hybrid of Commercial, Marketing and/or eCommerce Campaigns management experience

-Highly capable of influencing internal cross functional teams and external partners

-Demonstrated ability to embrace change and motivate teams towards common team/organizational goals.

rows.title: Head of Regulatory Affairs Thailand and LCM (Innovative Medicine)
rows.description:
Essential Job Duties And Responsibilities


  • Compliance Management: The Regulatory Affairs Head is responsible for staying abreast of all applicable regulations and ensuring that the company's policies and practices align with these requirements.
  • Regulatory Strategy: Developing and implementing regulatory strategies that support the overall business objectives of the company. This includes planning for product registrations, approvals, and compliance activities.
  • Communication with Regulatory Agencies: Serving as the main point of contact between the company and regulatory agencies. This involves submitting applications, responding to queries, and facilitating inspections or audits.
  • Product Registration and Life-Cycle Maintenance: Overseeing the preparation and submission of regulatory documents and applications required for product approval or market authorization.
  • Policy Development: Developing and maintaining internal regulatory policies and procedures to ensure that the company's practices align with regulatory requirements.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborating with other departments such as research and development, quality assurance, marketing, and legal to ensure that regulatory considerations are integrated into all aspects of the business.
  • Risk Management: Identifying and assessing regulatory risks and developing strategies to mitigate them.
  • Training and Education: Providing training to employees on regulatory requirements and changes to ensure a company-wide understanding of compliance obligations.
  • Advisory Role: Providing strategic regulatory advice to senior management and other stakeholders to inform decision-making processes.
  • Monitoring Industry Trends: Keeping abreast of changes in the regulatory environment, Industry standards, and best practices to ensure the company's ongoing compliance and competitiveness.
  • Others: Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor.


Qualifications: Minimum Qualification


Education:


  • A bachelor's degree in pharmacy or a related discipline is typically the minimum requirement.
  • Understanding of the technical and scientific aspects of the industry


Experience:


  • Substantial experience minimum 15 years or more in regulatory affairs within the pharmaceuticals
  • Progressive experience in roles of increasing responsibility, including leadership or management positions in regulatory affairs.


Regulatory Knowledge:


  • In-depth knowledge of Thailand, LCM and international regulatory requirements and standards relevant to the pharmaceuticals
  • Experience dealing with ThFDA and a proven track record of successful interactions.


Leadership and Management Skills:


  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead and manage a team of regulatory professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement regulatory strategies that align with business goals.


Communication Skills:


  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively interact with internal teams, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.
  • The ability to convey complex regulatory information in a clear and understandable manner


Problem-Solving and Decision-Making:


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to navigate complex regulatory issues.
  • The ability to make informed and timely decisions in accordance with regulatory requirements.


Project Management:


  • Proficient project management skills to coordinate and execute regulatory activities within specified timelines. Experience overseeing multiple projects simultaneously.

Strategic Thinking:


  • Strategic thinking and the ability to align regulatory activities with the overall business strategy.


Attention to Detail:


  • Strong attention to detail, crucial for ensuring accuracy and completeness in regulatory submissions.

Continuous Learning:


  • A commitment to staying updated on changes in regulatory requirements and industry trends.


Other requirements


  • Pharmacist License in Thailand

rows.description:
หน้าที่รับผิดชอบ

1. จัดทำกรอบการบริหารภาพรวมความเสี่ยงของธุรกิจอสังหาริมทรัพย์ (Real Estate Risk Management) ความเสี่ยงโครงการ (Project Risk Management Framework) และพัฒนาเครื่องมือที่ใช้วัดและติดตามความเสี่ยงที่เหมาะสมตามมาตรฐานสากล

2. วิเคราะห์ภาพรวมความเสี่ยงของธุรกิจอสังหาริมทรัพย์ (Real Estate Risk Management) รายงานความเสี่ยงโครงการ (Project Risk) พร้อมทั้งระบุสาเหตุ และจัดทำแผนปรับลดความเสี่ยงร่วมกับหน่วยธุรกิจและรายโครงการ เพื่อนำเสนอต่อคณะกรรมการกำกับ การบริหารความเสี่ยง และ

คณะกรรมการที่เกี่ยวข้อง

3. ประเมินความเสี่ยงในกระบวนการเข้าซื้อที่ดินของบริษัท (Land Risk Assessment) รวมถึงการลงทุนในธุรกิจใหม่ และ Recurring Income

4. สนับสนุนให้เกิดวัฒนธรรมการบริหารความเสี่ยงให้เกิดขึ้นในองค์กร (Risk Culture)


คุณสมบัติ

  • การศึกษา : ปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป สาขาเศรษฐศาสตร์ การเงินการบัญชี การธนาคาร หรือสาขาที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์ด้านการวิเคราะห์อุตสาหกรรม, วิเคราะห์หลักทรัพย์, วิเคราะห์ภาพรวมเศรษฐกิจระดับมหภาค หรือการ
  • บริหารความเสี่ยง หรือมีประสบการณ์ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับอสังหาริมทรัพย์, การทำ Project Feasibility Study / Project Budget ไม่น้อยกว่า 5 ปี และการบริหารจัดการไม่น้อยกว่า 2 ปี
  • มีทักษะความสามารถในการจัดการและการวางแผนงาน
  • มีกระบวนการในการวิเคราะห์ปัญหาและป้องกันปัญหารวมทั้งการทำงานแบบเชิงรุก (Proactive)

rows.title: Technology Engineer
rows.description:
Your Role and Responsibilities

An AI Engineer at IBM is not just a job title - it's a mindset. You'll leverage the watsonx platform to co-create AI value with clients, focusing on technology patterns to enhance repeatability and delight clients.

Success is our passion, and your accomplishments will reflect this, driving your career forward, propelling your team to success, and helping our clients to thrive.


Day-to-Day Duties

  • Proof of Concept (POC) Development: Develop POCs to validate and showcase the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed AI solutions. Collaborate with development teams to implement and iterate on POCs, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.
  • Collaboration and Project Management: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, software engineers, and project managers, to ensure smooth execution and successful delivery of AI solutions. Effectively communicate project progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
  • Customer Engagement and Support: Act as a technical point of contact for customers, addressing their questions, concerns, and feedback. Provide technical support during the solution deployment phase and offer guidance on AI-related best practices and use cases.
  • Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document solution architectures, design decisions, implementation details, and lessons learned. Create technical documentation, white papers, and best practice guides. Contribute to internal knowledge sharing initiatives and mentor new team members.
  • Industry Trends and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in AI, foundation models, and large language models. Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to assess their potential impact on solution design and implementation.


Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Education: Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Strong programming skills, with proficiency in Python and experience with AI frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras or Hugging Face. Understanding in the usage of libraries such as SciKit Learn, Pandas, Matplotlib, etc. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP) and related services is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Engage with stakeholders for analysis and implementation. Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with advancements in the field of AI.
  • Growth mindset: Demonstrate a growth mindset to understand clients' business processes and challenges.


Preferred Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering AI solutions, with a focus on foundation models, large language models, exposure to open source, or similar technologies. Experience in natural language processing (NLP) and text analytics is highly desirable. Understanding of machine learning and deep learning algorithms.

rows.title: Safety Specialist
rows.description:
Responsibilities

Professional safety officers in Thailand contribute significantly to a safer work environment for employees and a more sustainable business operation for companies. The job responsibilities include:


Compliance and Regulations

  • Overseeing adherence to Thai safety, health, and working environment laws and regulations.
  • Regularly inspecting workplaces to identify and address any non-compliance issues.
  • Staying updated on changes in relevant regulations and advising employers on necessary adjustments.


Risk Assessment and Prevention

  • Proactively assessing potential hazards within the workplace.
  • Analyzing work processes and projects to identify safety risks.
  • Implementing preventive measures to minimize the likelihood of accidents and injuries.
  • Recommending and overseeing the implementation of safe work procedures.


Training and Awareness

  • Developing and delivering training programs on occupational health and safety (OH&S) for employees.
  • Educating staff about safety protocols, hazard identification, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Promoting a culture of safety within the organization.


Incident Management

  • Investigating work-related incidents and injuries to determine root causes.
  • Preparing comprehensive reports on workplace accidents and safety issues.
  • Recommending corrective actions and preventive measures to prevent similar incidents in the future.


Liaison and Communication

  • Collaborating with company management to integrate safety measures into overall operations.
  • Maintaining communication with relevant government agencies on safety compliance matters.


Additional Responsibilities

  • Conducting safety audits and recommending improvements.
  • Managing safety data and records.
  • Participating in emergency preparedness planning and drills.


Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Hold a bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as safety engineering or occupational health.
  • Complete specific safety officer training programs as mandated by Thai law.
  • Knowledge of regional regulations /standards
  • Possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Have excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Competency in Microsoft applications, including Word, Excel, Powerpoint
  • Proactively engaged self-starter with ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
  • Must be legally eligible to work in Country of posting
  • High level work ethics and attitude.


Preferred Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree in safety engineering or occupational health.
  • At least 2 years’ experience in applying occupational health and safety principles
  • Experience covering a broad type of work environments

rows.title: เจ้าหน้าที่ ทีมสนับสนุนงานระบบผลประโยชน์การขาย
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

ดูแลการจ่ายเงินเดือนระดับผู้จัดการฝ่ายขายสะสมเงินเดือนและพนักงานสัญญาจ้าง ตรวจสอบกระทบยอดและนำส่งภาษี หัก ณที่จ่ายของทุกช่องทางขาย ให้เป็นตามวัตถุประสงค์ของบริษัท และปฏิบัติตามกฎระเบียบของกรมสรรพากร รวมถึงตรวจสอบการเบิกจ่ายค่าใช้จ่ายของฝ่ายต่างๆ ให้ถูกต้องเป็นไปตามหลักของกรมสรรพากร และระเบียบการเบิกจ่ายของบริษัทฯ

1. สรุปเงินได้และภาษีหัก ณ ที่จ่ายจากผลประโยชน์การขาย และตรวจสอบบัญชีการหักภาษี ณ ที่จ่ายของฝ่ายขายทุกช่องทาง ให้ถูกต้องและครบถ้วน เพื่อนำส่งภาษี ภ.ง.ด. 1 (ภาษีบุคคลธรรมดา) ต่อกรมสรรพากรทุกเดือน

2. จัดทำ และตรวจสอบการจ่ายเงินเดือน โบนัส ของพนักงานกลุ่มสัญญาจ้างช่องทางการขายอื่น (AF) ให้ถูกต้องตรงตามคำสั่งฝ่ายบริหารทรัพยากรบุคคล

3. จัดทำงบประมาณเงินเดือนและสวัสดิการประจำปี ช่องทางการขาย AF เพื่อใช้ในการเปรียบเทียบงบประมาณประจำปี และประจำเดือน

4. จัดทำและจัดเตรียมเอกสารการสรุปรายได้และภาษีประจำปี (ภ.ง.ด. 1ก.) เพื่อทำหนังสือรับรองการหักภาษี ณ ที่จ่าย ม.50ทวิ ของฝ่ายขายและพนักงานกลุ่มสัญญาจ้างของบริษัท ภายในระยะเวลาที่กรมสรรพากรกำหนด

5. จัดทำรายงาน และติดตามหนี้สินลูกหนี้เงินยืมทดรองพนักงาน เพื่อนำข้อมูลมาใช้ในการสรุปรายงานการประชุมคณะอนุกรรมการติดตามหนี้สินประจำเดือน

6. ตรวจสอบใบสั่งจ่ายของฝ่ายบริหารลูกค้าสัมพันธ์ ฝ่ายยุทธศาสตร์องค์กร ฝ่ายสื่อสารการตลาด ให้เป็นไปตามระเบียบของบริษัทและหลักเกณฑ์ของกรมสรรพากรเรื่องการเบิกค่าใช้จ่าย (ม. 65 ตรี (3) และ (13))

7. จัดทำหนังสือรับรองหัก ณ ที่จ่ายตาม ม.3 เตรส ของบริษัทฯ ให้กับ คู่ค้า

8. จัดทำใบกำกับภาษีมูลค่าเพิ่มให้ลูกค้า

9. ให้บริการออกสำเนาหนังสือรับรองภาษีหัก ณ ที่จ่าย ม.50 ทวิ .ให้กับฝ่ายขาย

10. ให้คำปรึกษาเกี่ยวกับรายได้และภาษี ของฝ่ายขาย รวมทั้งให้ข้อมูลแนะนำในการยื่นชำระภาษีเงินได้


Qualifications:

rows.title: Marketing Officer
rows.description:
ความรับผิดชอบ :

  • รับผิดชอบงานด้านเอกสาร และจัดเก็บงานเอกสารทั้งหมด ภายในแผนกการตลาด
  • ประสานงาน จัดทำ จัดเก็บและรวบรวมเอกสารเกี่ยวกับบัญชี เช่น ใบเสนอราคา, ใบวางบิล, ใบสั่งซื้อ, ใบจัดส่งสินค้า ฯลฯ
  • ประสานงาน ทีม Trade & Sales & Others ในการจัดส่งและรวบรวมสื่อ รวมถึงรายละเอียดผลิตภัณฑ์ทั้งหมด
  • ประสานงาน HR & Corporate เพื่อประชาสัมพันธ์กิจกรรมภายใน และภายนอก
  • ประสานงาน Delivery ในการจัดส่งเอกสารต่างๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้องกับสัญญา การบริการ หรืออื่นๆ ที่ทางผู้ให้บริการร้องขอ
  • วิเคราะห์ยอดขาย รายสัปดาห์ และ รายเดือน ทั้งระบบ ภายในและภายนอก เช่น Nielsen (โดยทีมจะถ่ายทอดและสอนงานให้)
  • ดูแลการเพิ่มรหัสขายสินค้า สินค้าใหม่ เบิกสินค้า กับทาง Demand / Supply คลัง และหนาวยงานอื่น
  • รวบรวม และสรุปรายงานค่าใช้จ่ายกับฝ่ายบัญชีทุกครั้งเมื่อมีการจัดกิจกรรมการตลาดขึ้น
  • ติดต่อประสานงานกับหน่วยงานภายใน/ภายนอก ประสานงานที่เกี่ยวข้องกับแผนก เพื่อดำเนินการตามแผนงานที่ได้วางไว้ รวมถึงการจัดทำเอกสารและข้อมูลต่างๆเพื่อสนับสนุนแผนงาน
  • ทำงานตามโครงการที่ได้รับมอบหมาย และช่วยงานหัวหน้าทีมการตลาดตามความเหมาะสม


คุณสมบัติของผู้สมัคร :

  • อายุ 24 ปีขึ้นไป
  • ปริญญาตรีขึ้นไป สาขาการตลาด, ประชาสัมพันธ์, การบริหารธุรกิจ หรือ สาขาอื่น ๆ ที่เกี่ยวข้อง
  • มีประสบการณ์การทำงานด้านการตลาดไม่น้อยกว่า 1 ปีขึ้นไป
  • มีมนุษยสัมพันธ์ดี มีไหวพริบ สามารถแก้ไขปัญหาเฉพาะหน้าได้
  • สามารถใช้งาน Microsoft office (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoints) ได้เป็นอย่างดี
  • มีความรับผิดชอบสูง กระตือรือร้น มีเป้าหมายในการทำงาน และมุ่งหวังผลสำเร็จของงานให้สำเร็จลุล่วง
  • มีความคิดสร้างสรรค์ ทันสมัยหรือนำกระแส สามารถปรับใช้ให้ทันต่อเหตุการณ์ได้
  • มีประสบการณ์ด้านธุรกิจ Food & Beverage จะพิจารณาเป็นพิเศษ

rows.title: Logistics-Fulfilment and Infrastructure-HSSE
rows.description:
Job Description

Team and Role Introduction:

Managing all tasks related to HSSE and conduct risk analysis to identified effective CA/PA and improvement plans to close the gap, ensuring compliance with HSSE, Workplace Safety Regulations. Working from HSSE, procedures, specifications, site activity-based plans to ensure all operation risks/ hazards and environmental aspect are carried out adhering to standards of safety norms. To review HSSE plan and conduct regular safety audits at site and produce reports. Review any safety/ security concerns in case of any process change, automation installation/ adjustment. To ensures that HSSE compliances from standards procedure are met through the entire execution process.

• Providing Health, Safety and Environment related input to manage day to day operation.

• Provide leadership, guidance and direction concerning all facets of HSSE.

• Monitor and report, through monthly meeting, audits and inspections, on the compliance of the HSSE management system implementation and effectiveness, and make recommendations for improvement where appropriate.

• Be fully conversant with all government and Client health and safety legislations, regulations and guidelines; provide assistance and advice to the operation responsible for HSSE.

• Produce and implement safety plans to maintain legal compliance and incident reduction.

• Assist with the identification of HSSE training needs and induction.

• Produce HSSE performance reports as required. Promptly alert Client functional management of accidents and incidents.

• Review accident and incident report; be involved in the investigation and ensure that the findings are reported, appropriately shared and closed out, and ensure that the findings are reported, appropriately shared and closed out, and ensure that there is appropriate response to prevent future occurrence.

• Ensure HSSE system compliance and conduct periodic review; conduct and assist in regular HSSE reviews and audits.

• Implement and maintain ISO14001&45001 management system ensuring operation activities are fully comply with standard requirements.


Job Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in OHS or relevant HSSE.

• Possess certification in professional safety certification is preferred.

• Preferably with Logistics background.

• Understand the legislation and regulations for compliance within the particular industry: warehouse/ transport safety.

• Experience to manage ISO14001, ISO45001 and other management system is preferable.

• Good English communication skills (written and verbal).


Requirements/Qualifications(good to have):

• Strong HSSE awareness and commitment.

• Functional management, leadership, and team-building skills.

• Good knowledge in warehouse and transport safety management would be an advantage.

• Good computer skills and proficient in excel, word & power point presentation.

• Strong background in managing people/staff in multiple levels.

• Excellent communication skills both verbal and written.

• Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative management style.

rows.title: Regional Fulfilment Operations, Functional Manager-Logistics
rows.description:
Job Description

Team and Role Introduction:

As a Function Manager in Lazada Logistics Fulfilment Regional Team, you'll be part of an extremely motivated and experienced group of people. You will help drive operation excellence and be a key contributor in building the largest and most innovative tech-driven logistic company and ecosystem in South East Asia. This role sits within the Regional Fulfilment Operations team and you will be managing the end to end processes for your function, working closely with many internal cross-functional stakeholders across regional and country teams to drive strategic business initiatives and excellence in our Fulfilment Operations and Services. The ideal candidate needs to have strong organization and planning skills, can communicate and lead improvement projects effectively, driving successful execution and completion for the team to achieve their goals.

- Identify process improvement initiatives to raise productivity and cost reduction

- Manage project implementation through project management approach, plan and execute initiatives according to business requirements, escalate and resolve road blockers when needed to deliver outcome within agreed timeline

- Analyze and digest large amount of data along with providing insights to identify potential issues, risks and opportunities for Fulfilment

- Drive regular discussions with stakeholders, to uncover opportunities and gaps utilizing information and knowledge gathered from internal data analysis

- Ensure all roadmap initiatives are defined with clear measurable target and clear ownership

- Foster and strengthen a culture of cross-functional collaboration on project planning and execution, ensure transparency and timely communication to keep all involved teams updated and engaged in project development

- Manage communication of progress and alignment with overall strategy direction with management within Logistics community

- Lead and train local teams to understand and follow project methodology and utilise standard project documentation

- Monitor Operations performance indicators: Focusing on Cost and Productivity

- Be the subject matter expert in Lazada for Fulfilment Operations


Job Requirements

Requirements/Qualifications(must have):

- University graduate with relevant bachelor degree in business, supply chain management or related fields

- Minimum 3-5 years of proven career track in business analysis, consulting, logistics and supply chain, project management, with e-commerce background being a plus

- Enthusiasm for e-commerce, global supply chain, logistics and its opportunities

- Proactive, resourceful and open-minded, with superior analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, enjoy taking up challenges and developing creative solutions

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to work with multiple stakeholders in a complex and dynamic environment

- Fluent in English both spoken and written is a must; local language capability is hugely advantageous

- Open to frequent business travel

- Good presentation skills and proficiency in MS computer applications (Excel, PowerPoint) required

We believe online shopping should be accessible, easy and enjoyable. This is the vision Shopee aspires to deliver on the platform, every single day.

rows.title: Team Lead Fraud Operations
rows.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for fraudulent Transaction Monitoring System.
  • Proactively identify fraud trends that may impact business goals and targets.
  • Research internal and external data to identify risky behaviors and create strategies to minimize fraud.
  • Investigate fraudulent activity, dig through data to identify behavioral patterns.
  • Complete ongoing risk assessment and assess coverage and gaps along with loss trends.
  • Manage multiple teams of fraud agents to identify fraud, take action and review performance of individual members.
  • Propose new features on Shopee that can deter or prevent further fraud, and conduct necessary research and data simulations.
  • Report periodically to management in a clear and concise manner.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in related fields.
  • At least 2-3 years working experience, focused on team management and / or analytics.
  • High level of data literacy, strong analytical & investigative skills and critical thinking are required.
  • Problem-solving, positive and constructive attitude.
  • Highly adaptive, willing to accept new challenges if needed.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally to drive results across the organization.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate insights from data to business units.
  • Experience in E-commerce is a plus.
  • Experience in SQL or Python is a plus.

rows.title: Credit Card Manager
rows.description:
Key Responsibility:

As a Credit Card Manager within the Financial Services industry, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and optimizing credit card programs your responsibilities include:

  • Develop and implement strategic plans for credit card programs, aligning with organizational goals and market trends.
  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of credit card products, from conceptualization to launch, ensuring competitiveness and profitability.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments related to credit card portfolios, implement risk mitigation strategies, and ensure adherence to risk management policies.
  • Develop and refine underwriting guidelines for credit card applications, balancing risk and profitability while maintaining compliance with regulatory standards.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to create effective credit card marketing campaigns, promotions, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Regularly analyze credit card portfolios, monitor key performance indicators, and implement strategies for portfolio optimization.
  • Focus on enhancing the overall customer experience by identifying and implementing improvements in credit card processes and services.
  • Stay abreast of regulatory changes affecting credit card operations and ensure compliance with industry regulations and standards.
  • Lead and manage a team of professionals involved in credit card operations, underwriting, and customer support.
  • Generate and analyze performance reports, providing insights and recommendations for continuous improvement and achieving business objectives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field Advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Extensive experience in credit card management, including product development, risk management, and portfolio optimization.
  • Strong understanding of financial regulations and compliance requirements related to credit card operations.
  • Proven leadership and team management skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make strategic decisions.
  • Effective communication skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Familiarity with industry trends and emerging technologies in credit card services.

rows.title: Collection Management (ACSS)
rows.location: Suan Luang district, Bangkok City, Thailand
rows.description:
Key Responsibility:


As a ACSS Collection Management in a debt collection agency, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of the debt collection process, ensuring efficient and effective recovery of outstanding debts for our clients while maintaining positive customer relationships. Your primary responsibilities include but not limited to:


  • Strategy Development: Develop strategic plans and goals to optimize debt collection and improve rates in alignment with the company's objectives.
  • Account Management: Analyze delinquent accounts, client’s business, and identify trends to optimize collection processes.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor KPIs such as collection rates and take proactive measures to address deviations. Analyze data to identify areas for improvement and implement strategies to enhance collection efficiency.
  • Legal Compliance: Ensure adherence to laws and regulations governing debt collection practices, including fair practices and personal data protection.
  • Customer Engagement: Build and maintain positive customer relationships, handling inquiries, concerns, and negotiations professionally.
  • Technology Utilization: Leverage collection software, tools, and CRM systems to enhance efficiency in managing and tracking collection activities.
  • Team Development: Lead, coach and provide clear guidelines to collection teams to ensure adequate skills and developments to maximize their performance.


Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Proven experience in debt collection management or a similar leadership role, preferably in a financial services or collections environment.
  • Strong knowledge of debt collection laws, regulations, and best practices.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Proficiency in using debt collection software, CRM systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
  • Business proficient in English.

rows.title: Marketing Insurance Executive
rows.description:
Key Responsibilities:

As a Marketing Insurance Executive in the Financial Services industry, you will be need to have a deep understanding of insurance products and services, along with proven expertise in developing and executing effective marketing strategies and promoting insurance products and services to potential customers and expanding our client base. Your primary responsibilities include:


  • Develop comprehensive marketing plans and strategies to promote insurance products and services. Set clear objectives, budgets, and timelines, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure successful execution.
  • Conduct thorough market research to identify trends, customer needs, and competitor strategies in the insurance industry. Utilize insights to inform marketing strategies and product development.
  • Develop and execute marketing campaigns across various channels, including digital marketing, print media, events, and partnerships. Create compelling messaging and creative assets to engage target audiences.
  • Drive lead generation efforts to acquire new customers and expand the client base. Develop targeted marketing campaigns and initiatives to attract potential clients and convert leads into sales.
  • Build and maintain relationships with insurance partners, brokers, and industry stakeholders. Collaborate on joint marketing initiatives and promotional activities to enhance brand visibility and drive business growth.
  • Monitor and analyze the performance of marketing campaigns and initiatives, using data and metrics to evaluate effectiveness and ROI. Make data-driven decisions to optimize marketing efforts and achieve business objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards in all marketing activities. Stay informed about changes in insurance laws and regulations and adapt marketing strategies accordingly.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in marketing insurance, strong understanding of insurance products and services.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven mindset.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proficiency in marketing tools and platforms, including analytics software, and digital marketing channels.

company.name: PTT Global Chemical PCL
company.detailLocation: 555/1 Energy Complex, Building A, 14th - 18th Floor, Vibhavadi Rangsit Road, Chatuchak, Chatuchak, Bangkok 10900 Thailand.
company.introduction:
PTT Global Chemical Public Company Limited, or GC, is dedicated be a leading global chemical company that enhances people’s lives with innovative plastics and chemicals following our vision of Chemistry for Better Living. We operate a business that prioritizes the balance of environmental, social, and corporate governance alongside economic (ESG) efficiency, aiming to maximize resources use under the Circular Economy concept. GC focuses on innovating products and solutions that address megatrends while meeting the expectations of all stakeholders.


We are the only company in the world to have been ranked number 1 in the Chemicals Sector by the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices (DJSI) with the highest score for five consecutive years (2019-2023) by S&P Global. Also, we have been rated at Leadership Level (A List) in water management and environmental management in climate change by CDP.


GC is driving toward becoming a low-carbon organization while ensuring sustainable business growth by setting clear strategies and plans that are trackable, with aims to reduce greenhouse gas emissions for 20 percent by 2030 on our journey towards achieving Net Zero by 2050.

rows.title: Researcher - Emerging business (PE, PP Resin)
rows.description:
Major Responsibilities


• Develop product & application development roadmap for new application “program” in GC and target setting, in order to drive polymer business growth in strategic market, as well as creating business value by enhancing high value products and solution.

• Provide technical perspective to business team to develop Strategic Market Plan (SMP), New Application and Product Development (NAPD) and Rapid Market Assessment (RMA) as a team member.

• Lead product & application development including Ideate (with business team and/or customers) new products with differentiated value proposition to customers.

• Resin development, material compound formulation, application, and solution for GC polymers

• Collaboration to development team to design product properties and criteria of application test

• Support product engineering design and simulation (by collaboration to product designer)

• Support product prototyping and support business team to scale-up product/solution to the market

• Lead project in “Stage-gate” process to consideration of gate committee

• Manage and share knowledge; follow intellectual properties management that build-up product and business values to customer and leverage GC competitiveness.

• Strengthen “Innovation Culture” in “Emerging Application Development” team & leverage competency through leadership, coaching, performance management, core behaviors, functional & core competency, career path, engagement, QSHE to serve business growth and GC policy.

• Manage product and application development portfolio and performance and promote continuously improve guidelines, standards and procedures to ensure effective R&D projects execution under GC good governance (GRC) and risk management and sustainability.


Qualifications

• Has strong knowledge in PE, PP resin and its applications such as healthcare packaging/product applications

• Has knowledge or experience about compounding and product processing

• Proactively and high agility

• Fluence using English

• Master or Ph.D. degree in Polymer Science, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, Applied or Industrial Chemistry or equivalent

• 0–3-year experience in Industrial/Academic research experience in Product and Application Development of Polymer/Material science or related industry

Manage Share of Voice (SoV) monitoring and media dashboard to benchmark our SoV as well as media performance.

  • Working experience in the international environment
