rows.title: Senior Digital Governance & PMO
rows.description:
Key Accountabilities


Project Governance and Standards

  • Establish project governance framework, digital project investment framework with adherence to policies and strategy of organization.
  • Standardize and develop project management framework, guidelines, procedure, best practices, standard project templates, tools, and user manual.
  • Assist in digital use case development and project feasibility study. Provide consultations to business users, project leads and team members about project governance, investment, and related processes during project execution.
  • Identify opportunities and lessons learned for improving project governance, project investment process, project management and practices.


Portfolio Management, Stakeholders Management and Reporting

  • Develop and apply a project management framework, project prioritization framework to define and deliver a portfolio of digital projects/programs.
  • Track and monitor overall project portfolio including e.g., budget, benefit, timeline, performance indicators and target (KPIs) etc.
  • Generate regular project status reports and dashboards for stakeholders.
  • Escalate critical risks and issues to senior management when necessary.
  • Facilitate communication and collaboration among project stakeholders when necessary.


Resource Management

  • Assist in resource allocation and capacity planning for projects and digital transformation teams.
  • Maintain resource allocation records and assist in resolving resource conflicts.
  • Monitor resource availability and utilization and assist in resolving resource constraint issues.
  • Develop and execute manpower framework including e.g., staff recruitment process, procurement process, performance evaluation process, contract renewal etc.


Project Documentations

  • Establish and maintain a centralized repository for storing project documentation including project charters, plans, project progress report, project deliverables according to IT standards.
  • Ensure project documents have been accessed by specific persons according to

the agreed user access matrix for data security purposes.


Financial Management

  • Assist in digital budget reservation according to digital strategy and roadmap on yearly basis.
  • Monitor and control budget spending to ensure that the budget is sufficient and will be utilized as planned.
  • Provide consultation to team for budgeting and accounting process.
  • Provide reports and clarification on budget forecast and spending to budget team or finance team as per request.


Job Qualifications


  • Bachelor/Master's degree in business-related fields required
  • 5-10 years of experience in Project Management Office (PMO)
  • Strong analytical skill and systematic thinking skill
  • Advanced problem-solving and communication skills
  • Managable resource under limited constraints
  • Data analytic skills with prior experience in handling large complex data sets
  • Advanced skill of visualization and fluent in Power Bi and PowerPoint
  • Keen on portfolio management and be able to develop and enhance governance process and procedure to ensure project implementation will be simplified and well governed

company.name: Siemens
company.introduction: Siemens AG (Berlin and Munich) is a leading technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to cleaner and more comfortable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, the company creates technology with purpose adding real value for customers. By combining the real and the digital worlds, Siemens empowers its customers to transform their industries and markets, helping them to transform the everyday for billions of people. Siemens also owns a majority stake in the publicly listed company Siemens Healthineers, a globally leading medical technology provider shaping the future of healthcare. In fiscal 2023, which ended on September 30, 2023, the Siemens Group generated revenue of €77.8 billion and net income of €8.5 billion. As of September 30, 2023, the company employed around 320,000 people worldwide.

Shape the future of mobility with your qualifications and skills.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Analyzing actual operating results and identifying key financial and operating issues to be addressed; quantifies actual results versus forecast.

  • Performing financial analysis for the company financial status planning and controlling to comply with conditions of all stakeholders’ conditions (Lenders, shareholders).

  • Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related fields.
  • Minimum 4 years’ experience in banking or corporate finance function in any companies.
  • Experience in project finance is required.
  • Good financial planning and financial model knowledge.
  • Experience in power generation, renewable energy, hydropower, gas and infrastructure & utilities would be an advantage.
  • High accountability, strong analytical skills, and confidence in turning facts into recommendations.
  • Creativity, problem solving skills, negotiation and systematic thinking.
